elaine: starting a tiny canary at 5% now for deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-11. change window 11:00-12:00 UTC. dash: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23-11 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started — deploy-2026-03-23-11 at 11:01 UTC. Canary: 0->5% over 2m. logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23-11

tom: noticing rerank p95 jump at 11:03 — 120ms -> 450ms, small spike in errors too :thinking_face: https://dash.re/metrics/rerank

raj: infra quickcheck: no OOMs, no pod restarts. Host CPU steal up on a subset of nodes, could be noisy neighbor / kernel update on that pool.

elaine: holding at 5% and pausing further lifts for 10m. @deploy-bot can you pause auto-lift?

deploy-bot: action available: `pause`, `rollback --to <tag>`, `pin --version <tag>`. To execute run `/deploy action <action>` in-thread.

tom: vote: rollback to v2.3.0 — we saw similar latency difference in the last perf run.

raj: vote: hold+investigate for 10m, rollback if signals don't improve.

elaine: decision: pause rollout now. If no improvement in 10m, manual rollback to v2.3.0 and pin for the window. Opening an incident and adding owners.

deploy-bot: rollout paused. Incident INC-2026-143 created by deploy-bot. To rollback: `/deploy rollback --to v2.3.0 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-11 --reason "canary p95 spike"`.

tom: I'll collect traces and post to INC-2026-143.

elaine: will update release notes with a short note: "Canary paused for deploy-2026-03-23-11 due to rerank latency spike; investigating host CPU steal." Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
